persistence_boundary.authoritative_store: one application-managed SQLite database per canonical SOMA data instance
persistence_boundary.connection_policy: every authoritative SQLite connection is created by one SOMA-owned connection factory and verifies foreign-key enforcement before authoritative use
persistence_boundary.domain_access: domain/application code reaches SQLite only through owned repository/query/unit-of-work interfaces; arbitrary direct connections and cross-domain table shortcuts are forbidden
persistence_boundary.schema_governance: domain HLD/LLD packets own domain meaning; HLD-02 owns common relational, migration, integrity, connection, and publication rules
persistence_boundary.json_boundary: JSON is allowed only for explicitly named/versioned document contracts and never replaces normalized independently queryable domain facts
persistence_boundary.projection_boundary: rebuildable caches/projections may exist only when they own no unique fact and accept no independent authoritative write

transaction_boundary.unit: one accepted command or explicitly defined atomic command set
transaction_boundary.connection_scope: a transaction/unit-of-work owns its connection for the bounded transaction; connections are not an unsafely shared global mutable handle
transaction_boundary.rule: file parsing, workbook/mail processing, expensive computation, operator think-time, and other long work occur outside write transactions; the final mutation reloads/revalidates authoritative state and commits briefly
transaction_boundary.audit_relationship: required mutation/domain-event/audit persistence joins the same authoritative transaction according to HLD-14

migration_boundary.correction_model: accepted migration defects are corrected only by a later forward migration for non-disposable data
migration_boundary.readiness: authoritative service is not published until migration, schema, ledger, foreign-key and required integrity checks pass
migration_boundary.status_mode: migration/status inspection is observational and must not create, mutate, repair, checkpoint, migrate, or touch the target

runtime_coordination.durable_jobs: restart-relevant job/proposal/checkpoint state lives in the authoritative database under named schemas rather than volatile client memory
runtime_coordination.runtime_registry: minimal current-run discovery/coordination metadata exists outside SQLite and is non-authoritative; trust mechanics belong to HLD-13
runtime_coordination.diagnostics: technical diagnostics live outside SQLite and are non-authoritative; redaction/rotation/security belong to HLD-13
runtime_coordination.source_files: external workbooks/PST/OST/MSG files are not a second database and do not gain mutation authority by being present

delegated_design.domain_HLDs: domain entity/table meaning, relationships, state transitions, and domain indexes/constraints
delegated_design.HLD-13: database/live-data encryption implementation, backup/restore protection, diagnostics security, runtime-registry trust
delegated_design.HLD-14: transaction semantics, audit/event meaning, history, idempotency, temporal recording/effective time
delegated_design.LLD-01: SQLite library configuration, connection factory API, pragmas, journal mode, migration format/manifest, repository/unit-of-work implementation, job persistence schema, JSON registry/upgraders
